Metadata.Goal: 将长期 Decision Registry 改为 track/mission 完整 XNL decision forest 的递归、保真、可冲突检测合并结果，并安全迁移历史 decisions。
Metadata.Description: 修复 archive 的有损 Markdown decision promotion，扩展 codument-migrate decisions，并在本仓库执行可回滚 dogfood migration。

TaskSpace.name: upgrade-decision-registry-to-xnl
TaskSpace.Description: 先用测试冻结有损行为，再实现完整 XNL registry merge、archive transaction、migration skill 与本仓 dogfood。

TaskGroup.name: Characterize current decision loss
TaskGroup.Description: 用失败测试和 fixtures 精确冻结当前字段、层级、来源发现和重复 id 缺陷。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: 测试证明当前 promotion 会丢失完整 XNL AST 与 nested hierarchy
测试覆盖 root decisions.xnl 与 recursive decisions/**/*.xnl 同时存在
测试覆盖 duplicate id、activation/derived_from、unknown extension 与 durable child tree closure

Task.name: Add archive characterization fixtures
Task.Description: 构造包含 root forest、层级化 decisions、完整 answer/options、依赖/激活、嵌套 child 和未知字段的 archive fixture。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: fixture 能区分 full AST merge 与现有 Markdown projection

Task.name: Add failing promotion and discovery tests
Task.Description: 证明当前 root suppression、non-recursive directory scan、tree flattening 和 duplicate timestamp outputs 不符合行为 delta。

Task.name: Add migration inventory fixtures
Task.Description: 覆盖 archive-recoverable summary、Markdown-only record、missing source、ambiguous id 和 target conflict。

TaskGroup.name: Build reusable XNL registry primitives
TaskGroup.Description: 抽取递归 loader、stable-id index、serializer 与 conservative node merge，供 decision 并尽量复用 modeling/engineering。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: registry loader 递归扫描且排序稳定
serializer round-trip 保留完整 AST 和未知字段语义
merge 覆盖 add/add、same-field、delete/modify、move/modify 与等价幂等

Task.name: Extract recursive registry loader and index
Task.Description: 从 modeling/engineering 的重复实现中抽取通用文件发现、解析、id index 与 owner metadata。

Task.name: Implement full-fidelity serializer
Task.Description: 直接序列化 AST，不经 validation DTO；加入 parse-serialize-parse semantic parity tests。

Task.name: Implement conservative node merge
Task.Description: 按 stable id 和节点结构实现 merge/conflict，并保留 hierarchy/provenance。

Task.name: Refactor modeling and engineering adapters
Task.Description: 在不改变既有行为的前提下复用 primitives，运行原有 registry/merge 回归测试。

TaskGroup.name: Integrate decision archive transaction
TaskGroup.Description: 实现 track/mission decision source discovery、durable selection、node merge 和 atomic registry staging。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: root 和 recursive XNL source 同时参与
new archive 不生成 canonical decision.md
decision prepare/commit failure 不留下 registry 或 track partial state

Task.name: Collect full decision source sets
Task.Description: 统一 track/mission root decisions.xnl、recursive decisions/**/*.xnl 和 legacy fallback 的发现规则。

Task.name: Select durable tree closure
Task.Description: 按 eligibility 选择 accepted/resolved nodes，并保留解释 durable child 所需的层级上下文。

Task.name: Stage and merge decision registry
Task.Description: 把 decision registry 接入 archive staging transaction，按 id 合并 owner files 并校验 staged tree。

Task.name: Add rollback and failpoint tests
Task.Description: 覆盖 decision conflict、validation failure、partial registry replacement failure 与 track move ordering。

TaskGroup.name: Extend decision validation and VFS
TaskGroup.Description: 使 validate/show/URI resolution 理解递归 registry、全局 stable id 和完整关联。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: `decision://id` 与物理路径解耦
duplicate id 和 invalid references 有 file/id/layer reason
legacy explicit Markdown validation 保持兼容

Task.name: Add recursive registry validation
Task.Description: 扩展 decisions command 验证 registry、track/mission source set、hierarchy 与 dependency/activation references。

Task.name: Index decision URIs globally
Task.Description: 让 VFS/show 通过 stable-id index 解析 owner file，并对重复 id fail closed。

Task.name: Update archive summaries and compatibility views
Task.Description: 保留可派生 summary/provenance，但确保其不参与 registry merge 或 canonical resolution。

TaskGroup.name: Update decision standards and tests
TaskGroup.Description: 同步 std/templates 中关于 durable XNL、recursive sources、legacy Markdown 和 archive transaction 的权威口径。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: decision/archive/VFS 规范与实现行为一致
模板与 workspace std 不再要求新 durable decision.md
authoring/template tests 防止旧摘要语义回归

Task.name: Revise decision and archive standards
Task.Description: 更新 XNL、knowledge tiers、archive、VFS 和相关 action 文档中的长期 decision 规则。

Task.name: Update behavior and template assertions
Task.Description: 补齐 template/authoring tests，禁止新的 canonical decision.md promotion。

TaskGroup.name: Extend codument-migrate for decisions
TaskGroup.Description: 更新 migrate skill shell、authoritative body 和 bundled reference，支持历史 decisions 迁移。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: SKILL.md 支持 decisions/all 并路由 reference
decision-migration reference 说明 recovery、conversion、conflict、backup、manifest、verify 和 rollback
manifest/init/upgrade tests 证明 reference 被打包安装

Task.name: Create decision migration reference
Task.Description: 新增 `src/templates/skills/codument-migrate/references/decision-migration.md`，提供完整迁移协议。

Task.name: Route migrate skill to decisions
Task.Description: 更新 SKILL.md description/usage/routing 和 authoritative migrate action 的 what/flow/output。

Task.name: Add template packaging tests
Task.Description: 验证 manifest、init、upgrade-workspace 和 installed skill reference。

TaskGroup.name: Build upgrade and dogfood migration
TaskGroup.Description: 使用已构建的新版本升级当前 workspace，并安全迁移本仓库现有长期 decisions。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: 迁移前 backup/inventory/manifest 可恢复
七条 archive-recoverable records 保持完整 XNL 语义
Markdown-only record 保留原文 provenance 和所有 ambiguity
八条历史 identity 均有成功结果或显式 issue

Task.name: Build and install latest workspace templates
Task.Description: 运行 build 刷新 manifest，使用新 CLI 执行 upgrade-workspace，确认 migrate reference 安装。

Task.name: Inventory and back up current decisions
Task.Description: 记录八条 source、hash、archive mapping、target owner 与风险，建立可恢复备份。

Task.name: Run decision registry migration
Task.Description: 恢复七条完整 XNL nodes，保真转换 Markdown-only 文档，在 staged registry 中校验后提交。

Task.name: Verify dogfood semantic parity
Task.Description: 比较 id、AST/字段、hierarchy、provenance、hash manifest，并确认无 canonical lossy Markdown output。

TaskGroup.name: Final verification and gap closure
TaskGroup.Description: 运行 focused/full tests、typecheck、build、strict validation，并对行为目标做最终独立纠偏。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: decisions/archive/VFS/migrate/template/upgrade focused tests 全部通过
full test suite、typecheck 与 build 通过
`codument decisions validate` 与 `codument validate upgrade-decision-registry-to-xnl --strict` 通过
git diff 区分生成物、workspace upgrade 与 dogfood data migration
GapLoop 收口且 coding AttractorCheck PASS

Task.name: Run focused and full automated verification
Task.Description: 运行相关单测、全量测试、typecheck、build 和 template manifest consistency。

Task.name: Validate track and migrated registries
Task.Description: 运行 decisions validation、strict track validation、URI resolution checks 和 migration parity checks。

Task.name: Review final diff and rollback evidence
Task.Description: 确认无未授权数据删除、备份/manifest 完整、legacy sources 可追溯且 worktree 变更可解释。
